info.name: Vehicle Maintenance API
info.description:
Complete API reference for the NaArNi Vehicle Maintenance Frappe app deployed at https://service.naarni.com.

**Quick start:**

1. Import the companion environment: `vehicle-maintenance.postman_environment.json`.
2. Set `phone` + `password` in the environment to your credentials.
3. Run the **Auth → Login with Phone** request — it automatically stores `sid`, `system_user`, and `csrf_token` in environment variables.
4. All other requests use those variables via the Authorization + Cookie headers.

**Legend:** ✅ deployed · 🆕 pending backend work (placeholder requests included).

item.name: CRM (Leads) ✅
item.description: Lead pipeline for sales pitches — capture, qualify, log activities, schedule email reminders, convert winners to Customer. All endpoints require Sales Executive, Central Ops, or Administrator (read endpoints additionally allow Service Engineer). Every response uses the {success, data, message} envelope.
